name: Amazon Associates niche review/comparison site
summary: Hands-on 'best X for Y' comparison content linking to Amazon products for a commission on qualifying purchases.
howItWorks: Pick a narrow buyer-intent niche (e.g. tools for a specific hobby), publish genuinely useful comparisons, buying guides and spec tables, and link products with your Associates tag. Amazon pays a category-based % of purchases made within the 24-hour click window. Rates are low: Amazon US's official fixed table runs 0-10% by category (most categories 1-4.5%, e.g. 3% home/toys, 2.5% PC, 1% grocery/health), and 2026 trade press reports further cuts for some publishers, so volume and real first-hand testing are what differentiate a site from AI-generated competitors.

payout.minimumPayout: $10 for gift card and direct deposit (US); higher for check; GBP 25 (UK); varies by store
payout.notes: Official help: paid monthly, about 60 days after the end of the earning month (January earnings paid late March). New accounts need 3 qualifying sales within 180 days or are closed.

legality.notes: Affiliate marketing is legal across the reference set; disclosure required. UK ASA/CAP guidance: affiliate content must be obviously identifiable as advertising (e.g. 'Ad' label upfront); a footer disclaimer or vague 'may earn a commission' wording is unlikely to be enough.

availability.notes: Anyone can join any Amazon store; direct deposit only to supported banks per store, otherwise gift card/check. Content must target countries with an Amazon store (US, UK, DE, FR, IT, JP, CA, AU, BR, MX, IN, SG etc.).

automationPlan: Generate product data via PA-API (unlocked after sales) and keep price/availability fresh
LLM drafts outlines, spec tables, FAQ; human adds tests/photos
Automated broken-link and out-of-stock monitoring
Scheduled internal linking and sitemap updates
manualSteps: Buy/borrow and actually test products for first-hand claims
Amazon tax interview and payment setup
Editorial review to avoid thin/scaled AI content
risks: Google helpful-content/core updates can erase traffic
evidence: Amazon Associates is the largest affiliate program; official help confirms the ~60-day payout cycle and publishes the fixed category rate table (0-10%, mostly 1-4.5%). 2026 trade-press reporting describes rate cuts of up to 50% for some publishers, so expectations should be modest.

equipment: some products in the niche to test

unitEconomics.notes: Estimate: a 1-4.5% category rate on ~$40-60 orders at 3-8% click-to-purchase gives roughly $3-40 per 1,000 pageviews; cost is AI/hosting variable spend.

breakEven.notes: Fixed cost is recurringMonthlyUsd only; startup cash is not amortised. Break-even is ~2,000 pageviews/month, which new sites typically reach after 6-12 months of publishing. Startup recovery assumes about $20/month net at month 6.

marketConditions.notes: Winners are established sites with real first-hand testing and brand trust. Since 2024-2026 Google AI Overviews and helpful-content updates have cut clicks to review sites, and Amazon has trimmed category rates, so generic AI-written review sites mostly fail. Typical failure: 30-60 articles, little traffic, account closed for missing 3 sales in 180 days.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: No pricing control: choose niches with higher-rate categories (home, toys, luxury beauty) and higher order values, then add a second merchant/network so revenue is not 100% Amazon.
profitPath: Month 0: niche research, domain + hosting, 10 cornerstone comparison posts (cost ~$50)
Month 1-3: publish 20-40 tested reviews; expect $0-10 and must hit 3 sales within 180 days
Month 3-6: build internal links and refresh posts that rank on page 2; expect $10-50/month
Month 6-12: double down on winning clusters, add email list and other merchants; median ~$30/month

name: Affiliate-network content site with programmatic SEO (Awin, CJ, Impact, Rakuten)
summary: Data-driven pages (comparisons, alternatives, 'X vs Y', location/spec pages) monetized with merchant programs from major networks.
howItWorks: Join networks such as Awin (absorbed ShareASale in 2025), CJ, Impact and Rakuten, get approved by merchants in one vertical (e.g. software, travel gear, home services), then generate many structured pages from a real dataset (specs, prices, features) with unique analysis per page. Merchants pay CPA/CPS commissions (typically 5-30%, cookie windows 30-90 days set per merchant).

payout.minimumPayout: Awin 20 GBP/EUR/USD (selectable; default 50); Impact $10; CJ and Rakuten thresholds not re-verified (commonly cited ~$50)
payout.frequency: twice monthly (Awin, CJ) / threshold or fixed-day autopay (Impact)
payout.notes: Commissions lock only after merchant validation (30-90 days) before becoming payable. Impact PayPal payouts carry a 2% fee (max $20); domestic EFT is free. CJ pays twice monthly via direct deposit (150+ currencies) or Payoneer.

legality.notes: Legal everywhere in the reference set; Google spam policies (scaled content abuse) are a ranking risk, not a legal one.

availability.notes: Networks accept publishers from most countries; merchant approval is per program and often favours established sites. Some merchants only accept traffic from specific countries.

automationPlan: Ingest merchant product feeds/APIs into a database
Template + LLM generate pages with unique per-entity commentary
Auto-refresh prices, deals and dead links from feeds
Track EPC per page and prune losers
manualSteps: Network and merchant applications (often manual review)
evidence: Official Awin help: twice-monthly payments with a selectable 20 GBP/EUR/USD threshold (default 50). Official Impact help: $10 minimum threshold, payouts on the Tuesday/Thursday after threshold or on the 1st/15th. CJ's publisher page confirms two payouts per month. These are mainstream networks paying thousands of publishers.

skills: basic scripting (an AI coding agent covers most of it)
accounts: Awin, CJ, Impact and/or Rakuten publisher accounts + tax forms

unitEconomics.notes: Estimate: network CPA/CPS of 5-30% on software, travel and home-service offers converts better than Amazon; variable cost is data/API spend.

breakEven.notes: Fixed cost is recurringMonthlyUsd only; startup cash is not amortised. Commissions lock 30-90 days after the sale, so cash break-even lags traffic break-even by 1-3 months. Startup recovery assumes about $20/month net at month 6.

marketConditions.notes: Programmatic sites that win are built on proprietary or hard-to-gather data with real per-page analysis. Google's 2024-2025 scaled-content-abuse and site-reputation policies deindex thin template pages, and AI answers reduce clicks. Common failures: merchant approval refusals for new sites, then a traffic spike followed by a core-update collapse.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: Commissions are set by merchants; after you show volume, ask merchants for tiered or custom rates (often +2-5 points) and prioritise recurring or high-CPA offers.
profitPath: Month 0: pick a vertical, assemble a dataset, build templates, apply to 10-20 merchants (cost ~$50)
Month 1-3: publish 200-1,000 pages with unique analysis; expect $0-20
Month 3-6: prune pages without impressions, enrich winners; expect $20-100/month
Month 6-12: negotiate rates, add comparison tools; median ~$50/month, top sites $1k+

name: SaaS recurring-commission affiliate via tutorials and YouTube
summary: Teach people to use hosting, dev tools or AI tools and earn recurring or high one-time commissions on signups.
howItWorks: Create step-by-step tutorials (blog + YouTube + GitHub templates) that solve a concrete problem with a tool, e.g. 'deploy X on a VPS' or 'automate Y with an AI tool'. Viewers who sign up through your link generate commissions. Official 2026 terms: Kit (ConvertKit) pays 50% of a referral's first 12 months, plus 10% lifetime recurring once you refer 10 paying customers in a year; ElevenLabs pays up to 22% for 12 months; Semrush pays one-time $50-$300 per sale (up to $450 at higher tiers) plus $10 per trial with a 120-day cookie; Hostinger starts at 40% per sale. Notion's program (20% of first-year revenue) is currently not accepting new affiliates. Recurring revenue compounds as tutorials keep ranking.

payout.minimumPayout: Commonly $5-$50 depending on program (PartnerStack $5, e.g. Kit; Impact $10, e.g. Semrush)
payout.notes: Programs hold commissions for refunds before paying (Kit: 31-day hold, withdrawable from $5 around the 13th of each month via PartnerStack: Stripe, PayPal or direct deposit by region).

legality.notes: Legal everywhere; follow each program's rules.

availability.notes: Most SaaS programs accept affiliates worldwide and pay via PayPal/Stripe; a few exclude sanctioned countries.

automationPlan: AI drafts tutorial scripts and code samples; agent verifies the code runs
Auto-generate blog post from video transcript
Link management with UTM + per-program dashboards
Monitor tool pricing changes and update content
manualSteps: Recording or voicing videos (or AI voice with disclosure)
risks: Programs cut rates or end recurring terms
Trust damage if you shill weak tools
evidence: Official affiliate pages (Nov 2026): Kit 50% for 12 months + 10% lifetime after 10 referrals/year, 90-day cookie; ElevenLabs up to 22% for 12 months; Semrush $50-$300 per sale + $10 per trial, 120-day cookie, hosted on Impact; Hostinger at least 40% per sale. Notion is closed to new affiliates, a reminder that programs change.

tools: free trials of the tools you teach
AI script and editing helpers (free tiers)

unitEconomics.notes: Official 2026 terms: Semrush $50-300 per sale, Kit 50% of first 12 months, Hostinger 40%+ per sale; median assumes a ~$60 average first-year commission. Fee is PayPal payout (~2%).

breakEven.notes: No fixed monthly cost, so any commission is profit; months count ramp-up to the first payable earnings. First referrals usually come 2-6 months after tutorials start ranking, then refund holds add ~30 days.

marketConditions.notes: Winners are practitioners whose tutorials solve a concrete job and keep ranking on YouTube and Google for years. AI makes scripting and editing cheap, but AI search answers absorb some how-to traffic and programs like Notion's have closed to new affiliates. Failure mode: generic 'top 10 AI tools' content with no conversions.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: Promote tools whose recurring commission covers 12+ months; once a tutorial converts, ask the vendor's partner manager for a higher tier or a custom discount code for your audience.
profitPath: Month 0: pick 3-5 tools you actually use, join their programs, publish 4 tutorials (cost $0)
Month 1-2: 2 tutorials/week with GitHub templates; expect $0-30
Month 3-6: update winners, add comparison and migration guides; expect $30-200/month
Month 6-12: recurring commissions stack; median ~$80/month, top channels $1k+

name: Amazon Influencer Program shoppable product videos
summary: Upload short product review videos that Amazon shows on product pages; earn commission when shoppers buy after viewing.
howItWorks: After acceptance (social account review) and onsite approval of test videos, you record honest 1-3 minute reviews of products you own and upload them to Amazon. Amazon places them on product detail pages; purchases attributed to your video earn onsite commissions, plus storefront/link commissions. Income comes from a growing video library without needing your own traffic. Payer is Amazon via the Associates payment system.

payout.notes: Same Associates payment cycle (~60 days after month end); onsite earnings use a separate Onsite Store ID that needs its own payment and tax info. Official US onsite rates (Table A) are 0-4% by category, mostly 0.5-3% (e.g. home 3%, beauty 2%, apparel 1%, books/toys/electronics 0.5%); Creator Ads (Table B) pay 0.5-5%. UK onsite table runs 0-6%.

legality.notes: Legal; videos must be genuine reviews of products you have used (no fake/incentivized reviews).

availability.notes: Most mature in Amazon US; also UK, DE, CA, IN and other stores with smaller programs. Shoppers must be in the store's market.

automationPlan: Shot lists and scripts drafted by AI from product specs/reviews
Batch editing/captioning templates
Track which ASINs have few videos
Upload queue and performance tracking
manualSteps: Physically handle and film products (unavoidable physical step)
risks: Onsite rates are low (mostly 0.5-3%) and change
Product costs if not already owned
evidence: Amazon's official help publishes the onsite commission tables (US Table A 0-4%, Creator Ads up to 5%; UK up to 6%), well below standard Associates rates. Creator reports range from hundreds to thousands per month for large libraries, though data is mostly self-reported.

skills: picking products with high search volume and few videos
equipment: products you already own or buy
accounts: Amazon Influencer Program acceptance (social account review)
separate Onsite Store ID with tax and payment info

unitEconomics.notes: Estimated (Amazon's help pages publish the onsite rate tables, but not per-video sales): creator-reported libraries average roughly $0.5-5 per video per month at 0.5-4% onsite rates; median assumes ~$10/video/year. Products already owned cost $0.

breakEven.notes: No fixed monthly cost, so any commission is profit; months count ramp-up to the first payable earnings. Earnings start once videos are approved and placed; payment ~60 days after month end. Startup recovery assumes about $30/month net at month 6.

marketConditions.notes: Winners upload hundreds of honest videos on products with many searches and few existing videos. Amazon has cut onsite rates (now mostly 0.5-3%) and the US carousel is crowded, so per-video earnings keep falling. Failure: low approval of test videos or a library of under 100 videos earning cents each.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: No pricing control; raise income per hour by targeting high-ticket home and kitchen products and being first to review new listings.
profitPath: Month 0: apply, film test videos, buy basic gear (cost ~$100)
Month 1-2: upload 30-60 videos of owned products; expect $5-30
Month 3-6: 20+ videos/week on new-release products; expect $30-150/month
Month 6-12: 300-500 video library; median ~$100/month

name: Curated coupon and deal aggregator site
summary: Publish verified coupons/deals in a niche and earn affiliate commissions when users shop through them.
howItWorks: Build a niche deal site (e.g. developer tools, outdoor gear, a specific country's e-commerce) that verifies codes and curates time-limited deals, ideally with a deals newsletter and alerts. Clicks go through merchant affiliate links or a sub-network (Skimlinks, Sovrn Commerce) which auto-affiliates thousands of merchants. You only list codes merchants actually released; paying publishers are merchants via networks. Generic coupon SEO is heavily contested and Google penalises third-party coupon sections on unrelated sites.

payout.minimumPayout: Skimlinks reportedly $65/EUR55/GBP50; Sovrn ~$25; networks $10-50 (Skimlinks/Sovrn not re-verified: official help pages blocked automated access)
payout.notes: Sub-networks pay after merchants pay them, often 60-90 days after month end.

legality.notes: Legal; never publish fake or leaked codes (consumer-protection law). UK ASA/CAP guidance specifically requires voucher sites to label affiliate offers (e.g. 'Ad' in or around the title).

availability.notes: Skimlinks/Sovrn accept publishers globally; merchants mostly US/UK/EU.

automationPlan: Pull coupon/deal feeds from networks' APIs
Auto-expire and verify codes
AI writes short merchant summaries
Auto-send daily deal newsletter
manualSteps: Editorial check that deals are real
risks: Merchants cancel commissions for coupon sites
evidence: Skimlinks' payment-schedule help page describes monthly payouts above a threshold (not re-verified: it blocks automated access); coupon sites remain a major affiliate channel, but 2024-25 Google enforcement removed many coupon directories.

skills: light scripting for feeds (AI coding agents help)
accounts: Skimlinks or Sovrn Commerce publisher account

unitEconomics.notes: Estimate: deal traffic converts well but sub-networks keep ~25% of commission (the RPM is already net of that cut, hence fee 0) and merchants cut coupon-site rates; variable cost is feed/AI spend.

breakEven.notes: Fixed cost is recurringMonthlyUsd only; startup cash is not amortised. Sub-network payouts arrive 60-90 days after month end. Startup recovery assumes about $10/month net at month 6.

marketConditions.notes: Big coupon brands and browser extensions dominate, and Google penalises white-label coupon sections, so generic coupon SEO is close to closed. Since the 2024-2025 extension cookie-stuffing scandals, many merchants exclude or underpay coupon affiliates. A niche deals newsletter with real curation is the only realistic angle.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: Commissions are fixed; instead monetise attention: after 1,000+ subscribers sell a sponsored deal slot ($25-100) to merchants in the niche.
profitPath: Month 0: pick a niche or country, build site and newsletter (cost ~$20)
Month 1-3: post verified deals daily; expect $0-10
Month 3-6: grow newsletter and alerts; expect $10-40/month
Month 6-12: add sponsored slots; median ~$30/month

name: Newsletter sponsorships and ad-network placements
summary: Grow a niche newsletter and sell ad slots directly or through beehiiv Ad Network, Paved or Passionfroot.
howItWorks: Run a focused newsletter (e.g. weekly AI tools for accountants) and earn when advertisers pay for placements: CPC/CPM via the beehiiv Ad Network, or flat-fee sponsorships booked through marketplaces (Paved, Passionfroot) or directly. Payers are brands buying attention of your subscribers. Revenue scales with engaged, real subscribers; buying lists or bot subscribers is prohibited and destroys deliverability.

payout.minimumPayout: beehiiv: no stated minimum (Stripe Express via beehiiv Wallet); Paved: $1,000 balance threshold (lower balances roll over)
payout.frequency: monthly (beehiiv on the 20th; Paved monthly) / per campaign for direct sponsors
payout.notes: beehiiv pays Ad Network earnings on the 20th for the previous month's placements (reports ~96h after send); PayPal/Wise not supported. Paved's publisher terms: paid within 60 days after month end once the $1,000 threshold is met; the marketplace platform fee is shown in-platform, not a fixed published %.

legality.notes: Legal; sponsored content must be labelled; email laws (CAN-SPAM, GDPR/PECR) apply to list building.

availability.notes: beehiiv Ad Network is open to anyone on a paid beehiiv plan who is actively sending (no subscriber minimum, but small lists get fewer offers) and requires Stripe Express in your country. Paved/Passionfroot favour English-language audiences. Direct sponsorships need no platform.

automationPlan: AI curates sources and drafts issues; human edits
Auto-insert ad network slots
Media kit and rate card auto-updated from stats
Referral/boost programs for organic growth
evidence: Official beehiiv Ad Network FAQ documents eligibility and the monthly 20th payout; Paved's publisher terms document a $1,000 threshold and net-60 payout, which delays first payouts for small newsletters. beehiiv reports ad-network payouts of roughly $1M/month to creators (2026).

tools: beehiiv Lite plan ($49/mo annual, $59 monthly; the Ad Network needs any paid plan, Sponsorship Storefront needs Pro at $95-109/mo)

unitEconomics.unit: per 1,000 opens of one sponsored placement
unitEconomics.notes: Estimated: niche B2B newsletters sell placements at ~$20-50 per 1,000 opens and ad networks pay less (beehiiv says advertisers set each offer's CPM/CPC). The 20% is an estimated network/marketplace cut: neither beehiiv's Ad Network FAQ nor Paved's publisher terms publish a percentage.

breakEven.notes: Fixed cost is recurringMonthlyUsd only; startup cash is not amortised. Break-even needs ~4,000 sponsored opens/month (e.g. 1,000 opens x 4 issues). You can start on beehiiv Free (2,500 subs) and upgrade only when ads are ready. Startup recovery assumes about $20/month net at month 6.

marketConditions.notes: Winners are focused B2B or professional newsletters with 40%+ open rates where sponsors value the audience. Newsletter ad budgets grew in 2025-2026, but AI made launching a newsletter trivial so subscriber growth is the bottleneck. Failure: paying for a plan for months while stuck under 1,000 subscribers.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: Start with ad-network fill and one low-priced direct sponsor to collect testimonials, then publish a rate card and raise CPM as open rate and list size grow.
profitPath: Month 0: niche, beehiiv Free, domain, 4 sample issues (cost ~$50)
Month 1-3: grow to 500-1,000 subs via cross-promos; expect $0
Month 3-6: upgrade to Lite, run ad network + first direct sponsor; expect $50-150/month
Month 6-12: rate card and repeat sponsors; median ~$150/month gross

name: Pay-per-lead landing pages (B2B, solar, home services, legal intake)
summary: Build informational pages and calculators that generate consented leads paid per qualified lead by networks or vendors.
howItWorks: Create genuinely useful tools (solar savings calculator, B2B software selector quiz, 'do I need a lawyer for X' guide) that end in a clearly consented form or partner redirect. CPA/lead networks (e.g. MaxBounty) or vendor partner programs pay a fixed amount per qualified lead or signup ($5-$100+ depending on vertical). Incentivized or fake form fills are fraud.

payout.minimumPayout: MaxBounty $100 (or higher if you choose); vendor programs vary
payout.frequency: monthly (MaxBounty; weekly after first payment if on electronic payments) / monthly
payout.notes: MaxBounty pays about 15 days after the last business day of the month by default; leads can be scrubbed (rejected) for quality before payment.

restrictedIn: Insurance/legal lead referral needs a licence in some US states and EU countries
legality.notes: Lead gen is legal broadly; insurance, legal-referral and credit leads are regulated, so the score assumes unregulated verticals (B2B, solar, home services).

availability.notes: CPA networks focus on US/UK/CA/AU traffic; B2B vendor programs accept affiliates globally.

automationPlan: Auto-generated calculators/quizzes from public data
Server-side lead validation and dedup
A/B testing of landing pages
Pipe leads to network APIs with consent logs
evidence: MaxBounty's official site states a $100 threshold, monthly payment ~15 days after month end, and optional weekly payments after a first payment. Per-lead rates vary by offer.

tools: AI coding agent to build calculators
accounts: MaxBounty or other CPL network approval (phone interview possible)

unitEconomics.notes: Estimate from public CPL offers: B2B/home services $5-50, solar and legal intake up to $100+; ~$3 variable cost for tools/traffic; scrubbed leads are unpaid.

breakEven.notes: Fixed cost is recurringMonthlyUsd only; startup cash is not amortised. One qualified lead per month covers fixed cost; most networks also require minimum volume to stay approved. Startup recovery assumes about $25/month net at month 6.

marketConditions.notes: Lead-gen profits go to operators with organic traffic or efficient paid media and strict consent records. New publishers are often rejected by CPL networks, and AI answers reduce traffic to simple calculators. Failure: low volume, rejected leads, or consent violations that get the account closed.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: Network payouts are fixed at first; after 3 months of clean volume ask for a payout bump or move to direct vendor deals at 20-50% higher CPL.
profitPath: Month 0: pick vertical, build 1-2 calculators, apply to networks (cost ~$50)
Month 1-2: publish supporting content; first leads $0-25
Month 3-6: improve conversion and add vendors; expect $25-150/month
Month 6-12: negotiate direct deals; median ~$50/month

name: Fintech and brokerage referral programs via educational content
summary: Explain how to use cross-border money apps and brokers; earn official referral rewards when readers open accounts.
howItWorks: Publish neutral, factual guides (e.g. 'how freelancers in Kenya receive USD', fee comparisons) and include your official referral/partner link for apps like Wise, Revolut or Interactive Brokers. Programs pay fixed rewards per qualifying new customer: Wise's reward is set per region and shown on your invite page; IBKR pays $200 per referral (max 15/year, 30 total) but requires the referrer's own account to hold at least $2,000 and have made a securities trade. Never give personalised investment advice.

methods: credited to your account in the app -> bank withdrawal
payout.minimumPayout: No minimum (rewards credited per qualifying referral)
payout.notes: Rewards arrive after the invitee completes the qualifying action (transfer/deposit/trade). Wise: claim within one year of qualifying. IBKR: referrer needs $2,000+ net liquidation value.

restrictedIn: IBKR referral: residents of Japan, Denmark, Spain, Portugal, Poland, mainland China and Israel excluded (Japan is the only one in the reference set)
countries where a given app is not licensed
legality.notes: Referral rewards are legal; financial-promotion rules (e.g. UK FCA) apply to investment content: stay factual, add risk warnings, avoid crypto/leveraged products.
complianceRequirements: financial promotion rules: no personalised advice

availability.notes: Each app licenses only certain countries; Wise and Payoneer cover most of the reference set, Revolut mainly EEA/UK/US/AU/SG/JP/BR/MX; IBKR excludes some countries.

automationPlan: AI drafts and updates fee-comparison guides from public fee pages
Automated checks that referral terms/amounts are current
Track referral status per program
manualSteps: Hold a real account in each app (KYC)
Personal checking of terms in your country
evidence: IBKR's official referrer page: $200 per referral, 15/year and 30 lifetime cap, $2,000 minimum account value, exclusions for Japan, Denmark, Spain, Portugal, Poland, mainland China and Israel. Wise's official help confirms rewards can be earned repeatedly and are region-specific (amount shown in-app). Revolut terms not re-verified (page blocked automated access).

skills: clear factual explainers about fees and transfers
accounts: IBKR needs $2,000+ in your own account to refer

unitEconomics.notes: Rewards are per programme and region: Payoneer/Revolut small fixed amounts, Wise set per region, IBKR $200 (max 15/year).

breakEven.notes: No fixed monthly cost, so any commission is profit; months count ramp-up to the first payable earnings.

marketConditions.notes: Winners serve a specific audience (freelancers in one country, expats) with trustworthy fee comparisons. Programmes regularly shrink rewards or add caps, and financial-promotion rules restrict how products can be advertised. Failure: low traffic and referrals that never complete the qualifying action.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: No pricing control; prioritise programmes whose reward per referral is highest for your audience's country and that tolerate content links.
profitPath: Month 0: open own accounts, write 5 country-specific fee guides (cost $0)
Month 1-2: share in freelancer forums where allowed; expect $0-50
Month 3-6: add videos and comparisons; expect $20-100/month
Month 6-12: update fees monthly; median ~$40/month

name: Pinterest affiliate pinning
summary: Create original pins (images/video) that link to affiliate products or affiliate blog posts in visual niches.
howItWorks: Pinterest is a search engine for planning (home decor, recipes, crafts, fashion). You design original pins with keyword-rich titles that link either directly to affiliate products (allowed with disclosure) or to your own blog posts containing affiliate links, which is safer and diversifies. Pins have long shelf lives, so a consistent library compounds traffic. Payers are the merchants/networks behind the links (Amazon, LTK, Awin, etc.).

payout.notes: Pinterest itself does not pay; payout comes from the affiliate program.

legality.notes: Legal; Pinterest Community Guidelines forbid repetitive money-making pins, deceptive/excessive redirects, and multiple accounts used to manipulate the platform. UK ASA/CAP guidance: put 'Ad' at the start of the Pin description for affiliate pins.
complianceRequirements: Pinterest Community Guidelines (no spam, no deceptive redirects)

availability.notes: Pinterest available in most reference countries; traffic value highest in US/UK/CA/AU.

automationPlan: AI image/template generation for pin variations
Keyword research and title/description generation
Scheduled publishing via official API/approved schedulers
Analytics-driven reposting of winners
evidence: Pinterest affiliate links are widely used and allowed with disclosure per multiple 2026 guides; Pinterest added Amazon storefront linking for creators.

unitEconomics.notes: Estimate: ~3-8% purchase rate x $40 order x 3-10% commission gives ~$5-80 per 1,000 clicks; $1 is AI image credits.

breakEven.notes: No fixed monthly cost, so any commission is profit; months count ramp-up to the first payable earnings. Pins take 2-4 months to gain search distribution.

marketConditions.notes: Winners run blogs in home, recipe or craft niches and use Pinterest as a traffic source rather than direct-linking. Pinterest was flooded with AI images in 2024-2025 and added AI labels and user controls to see fewer AI pins, which hurts mass-generated accounts. Failure: thousands of pins, little click-through, cents of commission.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: No pricing control; route clicks to higher-commission merchants (LTK, Awin home brands) instead of Amazon once traffic exists.
profitPath: Month 0: niche, boards, 50 original pins (cost $0)
Month 1-2: 5-15 pins/day; expect $0-10
Month 3-6: double down on pins that earn saves; expect $10-50/month
Month 6-12: add a blog and email capture; median ~$30/month

name: TikTok Shop affiliate creator
summary: Promote TikTok Shop products in short videos/lives and earn commission on in-app sales.
howItWorks: Once eligible (18+, 1,000+ followers in the US, 500+ in the UK, plus an account risk review), you add products from the TikTok Shop marketplace to your showcase and create demo/review videos or livestreams. Sellers set commissions (commonly 10-30%) and often send free samples. Sales happen inside TikTok, so conversion can be high, but it requires consistent on-camera content.

methods: bank transfer via TikTok Shop creator wallet
payout.minimumPayout: Low/no minimum per market (withdraw from creator balance)
payout.notes: Commission settles after delivery and the return window, then is withdrawable to a linked bank. Exact settlement days and withdrawal minimums per market were not confirmed on an official page.

restrictedIn: Markets where TikTok is banned or restricted (none in most reference countries; check local status)
legality.notes: Legal; product claims must be truthful, and sponsored/affiliate content must use TikTok's commercial content disclosure.

availability.notes: Official TikTok Shop seller region list (Nov 2026): US, Mexico, Brazil, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, Japan, Germany, France, Spain, Ireland, Italy, Poland, Netherlands, Belgium, UK. About 13 of the ~50 reference countries are covered; creators elsewhere cannot participate.

automationPlan: AI scripting of hooks and product demos
Batch editing/captions
Track trending products and commission rates
Schedule posts
manualSteps: On-camera filming and handling samples (physical step)
evidence: Official TikTok Shop creator pages state the 18+ and follower requirements (US 1,000+, UK 500+); the official seller site lists 19 markets. Seller-set commissions of 10-30% are reported by third-party guides.

tools: TikTok app + TikTok Shop creator centre
accounts: TikTok Shop affiliate KYC + bank account

unitEconomics.notes: Estimate: commissions 10-30% set by sellers on mostly $10-40 items give ~$1-20 per sale; free samples mean ~$0 product cost.

breakEven.notes: No fixed monthly cost, so any commission is profit; months count ramp-up to the first payable earnings. Getting to the follower threshold usually takes 1-3 months; commissions settle after the return window.

marketConditions.notes: A small share of creators earn most commissions, usually with daily videos or livestreams in beauty, home and gadgets. TikTok Shop GMV kept growing in 2025-2026 but creator supply grew faster, and sellers trimmed open-collaboration rates. Failure: never reaching the follower bar or posting without sales.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: Start with open collaborations, then use sales history to request targeted collaborations at higher rates (20-30%) plus paid flat fees per video.
profitPath: Month 0: grow account in one niche to the follower threshold (cost $0)
Month 1-2: request samples, post 1-3 videos/day; expect $0-50
Month 3-6: double down on converting products, try live; expect $50-300/month
Month 6-12: negotiate targeted rates and flat fees; median ~$100/month

name: Creator storefront affiliate (LTK, ShopMy)
summary: Curate shoppable product collections and earn commissions across thousands of retailers through LTK or ShopMy.
howItWorks: Creator affiliate platforms aggregate retailer programs: you apply, then build storefronts/collections (outfits, home, beauty, gear) and share links on Instagram, blog, YouTube or newsletter. When followers buy, the platform collects commission from retailers and pays you your share; brands also offer gifting and paid collabs inside the platform. Works best with an existing lifestyle audience.

payout.minimumPayout: ShopMy $11 (confirmed); LTK threshold not confirmed on an official page (third-party reports say $25-$100)
payout.notes: ShopMy: commissions pending 30-120 days until the retailer pays, then paid weekly on Fridays via Stripe or PayPal. LTK help center blocked automated access, so its terms are unverified.

legality.notes: Legal; disclosure needed on every post.

availability.notes: Strongest for US/UK/EU/AU audiences; retailers mainly ship to those countries; creators elsewhere can join but conversions are low.

automationPlan: AI drafts collection titles/descriptions
Auto-sync collections to blog/newsletter
Track click-to-sale per collection
evidence: ShopMy's official payment FAQ documents the $11 minimum, weekly Friday payouts and 30-120 day pending period; LTK pays thousands of creators but its payout terms could not be re-verified.

unitEconomics.unit: per attributed sale (your share of commission)
unitEconomics.notes: Estimate: retailers pay ~5-20% on $60-150 fashion/home orders; the platform keeps a share and the rest is shown as your earnings, so the price already nets out the platform cut.

breakEven.notes: No fixed monthly cost, so any commission is profit; months count ramp-up to the first payable earnings. Commissions stay pending 30-120 days until retailers pay.

marketConditions.notes: Earnings concentrate in creators with engaged lifestyle audiences of 10k+; brand gifting and paid collabs inside the platforms are where most of their income comes from. AI does not replace the trust factor, but feeds are crowded. Failure: storefront with no audience gets no clicks.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: No commission control early; once you have conversion data, pitch brands for flat-fee collabs ($100-500) in addition to commissions.
profitPath: Month 0: apply to ShopMy (and LTK), build 5 collections (cost $0)
Month 1-2: post outfit/home content 4-5x/week; expect $0-20
Month 3-6: grow audience; expect $20-100/month
Month 6-12: add brand collabs; median ~$50/month

name: YouTube/podcast sponsorship marketplaces
summary: List your channel or podcast on sponsorship marketplaces so brands pay for integrated reads or segments.
howItWorks: Once a YouTube channel or podcast has a consistent niche audience, list it on YouTube Creator Partnerships (formerly BrandConnect, requires YPP in eligible countries) and third-party marketplaces (ThoughtLeaders, Passionfroot; Podcorn has been sunset). Brands pay flat fees or CPM for integrations, with briefs and reporting handled in-platform. This is distinct from affiliate links: payment is guaranteed per delivered placement rather than per sale.

payout.notes: Typically paid 30-60 days after the content goes live and is approved.

legality.notes: Legal; paid promotion must be disclosed (YouTube paid-promotion checkbox, spoken disclosure in podcasts).

availability.notes: YouTube Creator Partnerships: 18+, YPP members in 24 countries/regions (incl. US, UK, CA, AU, DE, FR, IT, JP, KR, IN, ID, PH, SG, BR, MX); third-party marketplaces mostly English-language audiences.

automationPlan: AI-assisted script integration and show notes
Automated media kit from analytics
Pipeline tracking of brand inquiries
evidence: YouTube's official help page documents Creator Partnerships (formerly BrandConnect) for YPP creators with its 24-country list; marketplaces publicly list paid campaigns.

skills: growing a niche channel or podcast
accounts: YouTube Partner Program membership (for Creator Partnerships)

unitEconomics.notes: Estimate: niche integrations sell at ~$20-50 CPM of expected views, so a 10k-view video earns ~$200-500; 10% is an estimated marketplace cut (most charge brands instead).

breakEven.notes: No fixed monthly cost, so any commission is profit; months count ramp-up to the first payable earnings. Only possible after an audience exists (typically 5k+ subscribers or 1k+ downloads per episode), which most people need over a year to reach.

marketConditions.notes: Sponsorship budgets are moving to mid-size niche creators, but brands buy proven view counts, so payouts accrue to channels that already grew. AI makes editing cheap but faceless AI channels face YouTube's 2025 'inauthentic content' demonetisation. Failure: never getting enough views to be booked.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: Accept 1-2 discounted first deals for case studies, then price at a fixed CPM on 30-day average views and raise it 20% each quarter.
profitPath: Month 0: list existing channel/podcast on marketplaces (cost $0)
Month 1-6: grow audience; usually $0 in sponsorships
Month 6-12: first 1-2 integrations if audience exists; $100-500 each
Month 12+: repeat sponsors; median at month 12 still $0

name: Niche 'best X' directory with paid/featured listings
summary: Build a curated directory (e.g. AI tools for lawyers, local coworking spaces) and charge vendors for featured listings and sponsorships.
howItWorks: Seed a directory with accurate, verified entries from public data, add useful filters and editorial 'best X' pages, and grow organic traffic. Revenue comes from vendors paying for featured placement, verified badges, sponsored slots, plus affiliate links on listings. Paid placements must be labelled as sponsored and must not masquerade as editorial rankings. Payers are businesses seeking visibility.

payout.notes: You set prices; common featured listings $20-$200/month.

legality.notes: Legal; sponsored listings must be disclosed; scraping must respect site ToS/robots and data-protection law.

availability.notes: Stripe available in ~45 countries; elsewhere use PayPal or Lemon Squeezy-style merchant of record.

automationPlan: Agent collects and refreshes listing data from permitted sources/APIs
AI writes listing summaries and category pages
Self-serve Stripe checkout for featured slots
Automated newsletter of new listings
manualSteps: Verify listings and handle vendor disputes
evidence: Directory operators report revenue from featured listings (e.g. $197/month slots) and sponsorships; most figures are self-reported.

tools: WordPress + directory plugin or static directory template
skills: basic web building (AI coding agents help)

unitEconomics.notes: Common featured-listing prices are $20-200/month (directory operators' published rates); fee is Stripe's ~2.9% + $0.30 (~4% at $50).

breakEven.notes: Fixed cost is recurringMonthlyUsd only; startup cash is not amortised. One paid listing covers fixed cost, but vendors only pay once the directory has visible traffic. Startup recovery assumes about $25/month net at month 6.

marketConditions.notes: Directories with a sharp niche and verified data (local services, AI tools for a profession) sell featured slots once they rank. AI made launching directories trivial, so generic 'AI tools' directories are oversupplied and launch-day traffic fades. Failure: traffic too low for vendors to pay.

businessPlan.pricingStrategy: Offer free basic listings and a cheap launch-price featured slot ($10-20) to the first 10 vendors, then raise prices as traffic grows and add annual plans.
profitPath: Month 0: seed 200-1,000 verified entries, build filters (cost ~$50)
Month 1-3: SEO pages and outreach to listed businesses; expect $0-50
Month 3-6: sell first featured slots; expect $50-200/month
Month 6-12: annual plans and affiliate links; median ~$100/month gross
